diagrams.name: Flowchart
diagrams.blurb: Nodes and edges for processes, decisions, and flows—the workhorse of the Mermaid family.
diagrams.code:
flowchart TD
    A[Push to main] --> B{CI checks pass?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Build container image]
    B -->|No| D[Notify author]
    D --> E[Fix and re-push]
    E --> B
    C --> F[Push to registry]
    F --> G{Deploy approved?}
    G -->|Yes| H[Rolling deploy to prod]
    G -->|No| I[Hold for review]
    H --> J[Smoke tests]
    J --> K{Healthy?}
    K -->|Yes| L[Done]
    K -->|No| M[Rollback]

diagrams.name: Sequence Diagram
diagrams.blurb: How actors and systems exchange messages over time—the classic for API and protocol docs.
diagrams.code:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant U as User
    participant C as Client App
    participant A as Auth Server
    participant R as Resource API

    U->>C: Click "Sign in"
    C->>A: GET /authorize (client_id, scope)
    A->>U: Login page
    U->>A: Enter credentials
    A->>C: Redirect with auth code
    C->>A: POST /token (code, client_secret)
    A-->>C: access_token + refresh_token
    C->>R: GET /profile (Bearer token)
    R-->>C: User profile JSON
    C-->>U: Signed-in dashboard
    Note over C,R: Tokens expire in 1h - the refresh_token renews them

diagrams.name: Class Diagram
diagrams.blurb: UML classes, members, and relationships for object-oriented designs.

diagrams.name: State Diagram
diagrams.blurb: States and the transitions between them—perfect for anything with a lifecycle.
diagrams.code:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Created
    Created --> Paid : payment received
    Created --> Cancelled : timeout
    Paid --> Shipped : packed
    Paid --> Refunded : chargeback
    Shipped --> Delivered : signed
    Shipped --> Returned : customer return
    Delivered --> [*]
    Cancelled --> [*]
    Refunded --> [*]
    Returned --> Refunded : refund issued

diagrams.name: Gantt Chart
diagrams.blurb: Tasks on a timeline with dependencies—a project plan that fits in a Markdown file.
diagrams.code:
gantt
    title Website relaunch plan
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Design
    Wireframes      :done,   des1, 2026-10-01, 2026-10-07
    Visual design   :active, des2, 2026-10-08, 2026-10-14
    section Build
    Frontend        :        dev1, after des2, 10d
    Backend API     :        dev2, after des2, 12d
    section Launch
    QA pass         :        qa1, after dev1, 5d
    Deploy to prod  :crit,   dep1, after qa1, 2d

diagrams.name: Quadrant Chart
diagrams.blurb: Two axes, four boxes—the classic 2×2 matrix for prioritization.
diagrams.code:
quadrantChart
    title Prioritize features
    x-axis "Low effort" --> "High effort"
    y-axis "Low value" --> "High value"
    quadrant-1 "Do later"
    quadrant-2 "Quick wins"
    quadrant-3 "Skip"
    quadrant-4 "Big bets"
    Dark mode: [0.3, 0.8]
    SSO login: [0.2, 0.9]
    Rewrite in Rust: [0.9, 0.5]
    New logo: [0.2, 0.2]

diagrams.name: C4 Diagram
diagrams.blurb: Experimental C4-model syntax for context, container, and component views of software architecture.
diagrams.code:
C4Context
    title Online bookstore - system context
    Person(customer, "Customer", "Buys books online")
    System(shop, "Bookstore", "Lets customers browse and order books")
    System_Ext(payments, "Payment gateway", "Processes card payments")
    SystemDb(warehouse, "Warehouse DB", "Tracks stock and shipments")

    Rel(customer, shop, "Browses and orders")
    Rel(shop, payments, "Charges cards via")
    Rel(shop, warehouse, "Reads and writes")

16-31: "Destination Port"
32-63: "Sequence Number"
64-95: "Acknowledgment Number"
96-99: "Data Offset"
100-105: "Reserved"
106-111: "Flags"
112-127: "Window Size"
128-143: "Checksum"
144-159: "Urgent Pointer"

diagrams.name: Block Diagram
diagrams.blurb: Composable blocks with columns and nesting for quick infrastructure sketches.
diagrams.code:
block-beta
    columns 3
    db["Database"] app["App Server"] cache["Cache"]
    block:net:3
        columns 1
        lb["Load Balancer"]
    end
    web1["Web 1"] web2["Web 2"] web3["Web 3"]
    lb --> web1
    lb --> web2
    lb --> web3
    web1 --> app
    app --> db
    app --> cache
